ogImage.alt: NoctaLink - An AI cognitive twin for sleep and focus

editorial.title: NoctaLink
editorial.tagline: An AI cognitive twin for sleep and focus
editorial.description: NoctaLink connects sleep and EEG biomarkers with behavioral check-ins to model cognitive workload, fatigue, and readiness. Its dashboard pairs neuro-cognitive analytics with an interactive 3D Cognitive Twin and personalized recovery guidance.
editorial.roleDescription: NoctaLink connects sleep and EEG biomarkers with behavioral check-ins to model cognitive workload, fatigue, and readiness. Its dashboard pairs neuro-cognitive analytics with an interactive 3D Cognitive Twin and personalized recovery guidance.

section01.title: See the signals behind your day
section01.description: Explore sleep architecture, EEG-derived features, cognitive readiness, fatigue trends, and check-ins in one experience. The 3D Cognitive Twin provides a visual state overview while the analytics connect longitudinal patterns to actionable recovery suggestions.

section02.title: Technology stack
section02.description: A full-stack analytics platform combining a typed React interface, WebGL-based 3D visualization, a FastAPI processing layer, and Supabase-backed identity and persistence.

section03.title: What’s next?
section03.description: Extend the cognitive-twin workflow through validated data collection, carefully evaluated baseline models, and better longitudinal comparisons between sleep, EEG-derived features, and user-reported focus. Present clinical or predictive claims only to the extent supported by evaluation.

editorial.challenges:
Explore sleep architecture, EEG-derived features, cognitive readiness, fatigue trends, and check-ins in one experience. The 3D Cognitive Twin provides a visual state overview while the analytics connect longitudinal patterns to actionable recovery suggestions.

A full-stack analytics platform combining a typed React interface, WebGL-based 3D visualization, a FastAPI processing layer, and Supabase-backed identity and persistence.

ogImage.alt: NexaSense - Turn handwritten notes into exam-ready knowledge

editorial.title: NexaSense
editorial.tagline: Turn handwritten notes into exam-ready knowledge
editorial.description: NexaSense transforms handwritten and digital study material into personalized learning resources using OCR, NLP summarization, semantic retrieval, and knowledge verification. It aims to make notes clearer, more reliable, and more useful for revision.
editorial.roleDescription: NexaSense transforms handwritten and digital study material into personalized learning resources using OCR, NLP summarization, semantic retrieval, and knowledge verification. It aims to make notes clearer, more reliable, and more useful for revision.

section01.title: From raw notes to usable knowledge
section01.description: Upload handwritten or digital notes, extract text through OCR, generate concise summaries, simplify difficult passages, and retrieve related material from a curated knowledge base. Learning preferences and progress tracking are intended to make the study workflow more personal.

section02.title: Technology stack
section02.description: A React and TypeScript learning interface connected to a Python API and AI pipeline, with Firebase for identity and learning data and a vector store for semantic retrieval.

section03.title: What’s next?
section03.description: Develop the planned mind-map experience, broaden supported OCR languages and study formats, and strengthen evaluation of factual corrections and retrieval quality. Assessment integration with Evalion can help connect study activity to learning outcomes.

editorial.challenges:

ogImage.alt: CrossWise - Predict maize hybrid traits from genomic and environmental data

editorial.title: CrossWise
editorial.tagline: Predict maize hybrid traits from genomic and environmental data
editorial.description: CrossWise evaluates virtual maize crosses using SNP markers, biological features, and environmental context. Its machine-learning pipeline predicts multiple hybrid traits, ranks candidate combinations, and uses SHAP explanations to make model outputs easier to interpret.
editorial.roleDescription: CrossWise evaluates virtual maize crosses using SNP markers, biological features, and environmental context. Its machine-learning pipeline predicts multiple hybrid traits, ranks candidate combinations, and uses SHAP explanations to make model outputs easier to interpret.

section01.title: Explore promising virtual crosses
section01.description: Model candidate parent combinations from SNP data, derive genomic compatibility features, and incorporate environmental factors such as temperature, rainfall, and humidity. Results can rank candidates across yield potential, drought tolerance, disease resistance, grain quality, and maturity while providing feature-level explanations.

section02.title: Technology stack
section02.description: An ML-backed web platform combining a prediction API, an interface for exploring candidate crosses, and model-explanation tooling to support more transparent breeding decisions.

section03.title: What’s next?
section03.description: Prioritize reproducible evaluation across held-out crosses and environments, calibrate confidence estimates, and document dataset limitations before using rankings to guide breeding decisions.

editorial.challenges:
Model candidate parent combinations from SNP data, derive genomic compatibility features, and incorporate environmental factors such as temperature, rainfall, and humidity. ogImage.alt: Cadenza - An AI vocal coach built around measurable progress

editorial.title: Cadenza
editorial.tagline: An AI vocal coach built around measurable progress
editorial.description: Cadenza analyzes singing performances through pitch tracking, vocal-stem separation, tempo-aware alignment, and explainable scoring. A native Android app presents sessions and coaching, while a FastAPI backend powers acoustic analysis and a web showcase demonstrates the experience.
editorial.roleDescription: Cadenza analyzes singing performances through pitch tracking, vocal-stem separation, tempo-aware alignment, and explainable scoring. A native Android app presents sessions and coaching, while a FastAPI backend powers acoustic analysis and a web showcase demonstrates the experience.

section01.title: Turn every practice session into feedback
section01.description: Compare a singer's recording with a reference performance. Demucs separates vocals from accompaniment, pYIN tracks fundamental pitch, and Dynamic Time Warping aligns performances with different timing. A weighted score breaks feedback into pitch accuracy, timing/onset accuracy, and pitch stability, with Gemini-powered personalized coaching.

section02.title: Technology stack
section02.description: A native Android client works with an audio-analysis API and DSP/ML pipeline, with a separate React-based web experience for the product showcase.

section03.title: What’s next?
section03.description: Improve coaching consistency with repeatable practice tests, evaluate pitch and timing metrics against suitable references, and make feedback easier for singers to translate into their next practice session.

editorial.challenges:

Demucs separates vocals from accompaniment, pYIN tracks fundamental pitch, and Dynamic Time Warping aligns performances with different timing. ogImage.alt: Harmonza - Make music through natural hand gestures

editorial.title: Harmonza
editorial.tagline: Make music through natural hand gestures
editorial.description: Harmonza is a computer-vision music interaction tool that recognizes hand gestures, maps them to chords, generates MIDI events, and drives real-time harmonization. It explores an expressive, hands-free alternative to a traditional MIDI controller.
editorial.roleDescription: Harmonza is a computer-vision music interaction tool that recognizes hand gestures, maps them to chords, generates MIDI events, and drives real-time harmonization. It explores an expressive, hands-free alternative to a traditional MIDI controller.

section01.title: Gesture in. Harmony out.
section01.description: A live gesture-recognition flow maps movements to chord choices, creates MIDI events, and sends the musical output through a VST-based harmonization engine. The repository includes a Python application and engine, plus a Java UI alternative.

section02.title: Technology stack
section02.description: A computer-vision input layer is connected to musical-event generation and a live audio/harmonization workflow.

section03.title: What’s next?
section03.description: Reduce response latency, expand the gesture-to-chord vocabulary, and test the mapping in varied lighting and performance conditions so gestures remain expressive and reliable.

editorial.challenges:
A live gesture-recognition flow maps movements to chord choices, creates MIDI events, and sends the musical output through a VST-based harmonization engine. The repository includes a Python application and engine, plus a Java UI alternative.

ogImage.alt: Percepta - Discover how you approach information

editorial.title: Percepta
editorial.description: Percepta is a JavaFX psychometric assessment app that uses a structured 15-question questionnaire to estimate a user's dominant perception style, then explains the result with animated visual feedback.
editorial.roleDescription: Percepta is a JavaFX psychometric assessment app that uses a structured 15-question questionnaire to estimate a user's dominant perception style, then explains the result with animated visual feedback.

section01.title: A perception profile in minutes
section01.description: Users answer 15 perception-oriented questions. The application calculates scores across visual, auditory, kinesthetic, analytical, and intuitive categories, highlights the dominant result with an explanation, visual percentage bars, and an option to retake the test.

section02.title: Technology stack
section02.description: A modular desktop application built with JavaFX and an MVC structure, using FXML for view composition and CSS for visual styling.

section03.title: What’s next?
section03.description: Make the interpretation language clear that results are a self-reflection aid rather than a definitive psychological diagnosis, and consider adding accessibility options and clearer breakdowns of scoring.

editorial.challenges:
Users answer 15 perception-oriented questions. The application calculates scores across visual, auditory, kinesthetic, analytical, and intuitive categories, highlights the dominant result with an explanation, visual percentage bars, and an option to retake the test.

ogImage.alt: Canteen Cuisine Commander - Skip the queue. Order ahead.

editorial.title: Canteen Cuisine Commander
editorial.description: Cuisine Commander is a campus canteen ordering platform for students, staff, and campus workers. It lets users browse a centralized menu, pre-order food, track orders, and earn reward points through role-based dashboards.
editorial.roleDescription: Cuisine Commander is a campus canteen ordering platform for students, staff, and campus workers. It lets users browse a centralized menu, pre-order food, track orders, and earn reward points through role-based dashboards.

section01.title: A smoother campus food run
section01.description: Users register by role, browse available dishes, place orders before reaching the canteen, and manage their cart and order history. A points-based rewards system encourages regular usage, while separate dashboards and order workflows support campus users.

section02.title: Technology stack
section02.description: A server-rendered web application using PHP for application logic, MySQL for data handling, and a straightforward HTML, CSS, and JavaScript interface.

section03.title: What’s next?
section03.description: Build on the ordering workflow with verified real-time order status, clearer canteen-side order handling, and carefully scoped payment and administrative reporting features.

editorial.challenges:

ogImage.alt: Spotifix - Your music, mood, and listening space

editorial.title: Spotifix
editorial.tagline: Your music, mood, and listening space
editorial.description: Spotifix is a music-listening web application with song discovery and search, a player interface, playlist/song management, user profiles, and a mood dashboard with weekly insights. Its repository pairs a React frontend with a Java Spring Boot backend.
editorial.roleDescription: Spotifix is a music-listening web application with song discovery and search, a player interface, playlist/song management, user profiles, and a mood dashboard with weekly insights. Its repository pairs a React frontend with a Java Spring Boot backend.

section01.title: Find a track for the moment
section01.description: Explore the music library, search and manage songs, interact with a persistent player, and view mood-oriented listening summaries. Profile and song management surfaces bring the listening experience together in a personalized interface.

section02.title: Technology stack
section02.description: A React client sits alongside a Spring Boot application using Spring MVC, Thymeleaf, Spring Data JPA, and PostgreSQL dependencies. Verify the precise client/server integration and deployed database configuration before publishing architecture claims.

section03.title: What’s next?
section03.description: Refine the connection between listening activity and mood insights, improve discovery and player usability, and make the insights transparent about how they are derived.

editorial.challenges:

ogImage.alt: Evalion - A fairer, exam-like online assessment experience

editorial.title: Evalion
editorial.tagline: A fairer, exam-like online assessment experience
editorial.description: Evalion is a web-based MCQ exam platform designed for timed practice and classroom use. It supports student registration, role-based exam administration, Excel-based question imports, automatic scoring, scorecards, and tab-switch detection.
editorial.roleDescription: Evalion is a web-based MCQ exam platform designed for timed practice and classroom use. It supports student registration, role-based exam administration, Excel-based question imports, automatic scoring, scorecards, and tab-switch detection.

section01.title: From question bank to scorecard
section01.description: Administrators create and manage assessments, import questions from spreadsheets, control score release, and review generated scorecards. Students register and complete timed MCQ tests in a responsive interface with tab-switch detection intended to discourage malpractice.

section02.title: Technology stack
section02.description: A Vite-based React and TypeScript frontend styled with Tailwind CSS and shadcn/ui, using Firebase services for hosting and authentication. A functions directory supports the project's server-side workflow.

section03.title: What’s next?
section03.description: Strengthen question validation and accessibility, make assessment integrity events transparent, and improve reporting for instructors as the platform grows beyond initial classroom use.

editorial.challenges:

editorial.title: Cesium
editorial.description: Cesium is a social discovery platform designed to connect people through niche interests and explainable common ground. Its visual direction draws on an interactive constellation metaphor, helping users explore interests, discover communities, and find natural starting points for conversation.
editorial.roleDescription: Cesium is a social discovery platform designed to connect people through niche interests and explainable common ground. Its visual direction draws on an interactive constellation metaphor, helping users explore interests, discover communities, and find natural starting points for conversation.

section01.title: Different interests. Unexpected connections.
section01.description: The product vision centers on an Interest Constellation, transparent interest-overlap discovery, conversation starters, complementary-interest discovery, and small communities. The repository README is explicit that it is an architecture blueprint; list only features verified as implemented in the live build.

section02.title: Technology stack
section02.description: A React and TypeScript application with Supabase planned for authentication and data services, PostgreSQL as the relational layer, and Tailwind CSS for the interface. The current repository includes Vite, automated test tooling, and Supabase project structure.

section03.title: What’s next?
section03.description: Turn the blueprint into verified, end-to-end flows: connect real profile and interest data, make discovery explanations traceable, enforce consent and privacy at the data layer, and test connection, messaging, and community workflows before describing them as shipped.
